title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for hypertension.

HPI
The patient is a 36-year-old woman presenting for a routine follow-up of her hypertension. She reports that she has been adherent to her current medication regimen and denies any associated headaches, dizziness, or vision changes. She notes that her blood pressure readings at home have been consistently within the target range. She denies any recent changes in diet or physical activity levels.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily
Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5mg daily

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. She appears in no acute distress. Blood pressure is 124/78 mmHg. Heart rate is 72 bpm. Respiratory rate is 16 breaths per minute. Lungs are clear to auscultation bilaterally. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs.

Assessment
Hypertension is well-controlled on the current pharmacological regimen.

Plan
Continue current medications as prescribed. The patient will return to the clinic in six months for a follow-up blood pressure check.

Problem List
COPD (chronic obstructive pulmonary disease)

Electronically signed, L. Moreau, DO, 05/14/2026
explanations: COPD appears only in a problem list and is not addressed in this encounter, so it is not supported for this date of service.

distractors.why: A problem-list entry alone does not show the condition affected care at this visit.
